description: Original, illustrative examples of medication classes that may deserve a closer look in older adults. NOT derived from any licensed or proprietary criteria. Must be reviewed and replaced by a clinician before clinical use.

rules.description: Sleep medicines on the active list.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Sleep medicine on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can raise fall risk and cause next-day sleepiness in older adults.

rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Benzodiazepine on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can affect balance, memory and alertness in older adults.

rules.description: Older-type (sedating) antihistamines on the active list.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Older-type antihistamine on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can cause drowsiness, dry mouth and confusion in older adults.

rules.description: Strongly anticholinergic medicines on the active list.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Anticholinergic medicine on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can cause confusion, constipation and trouble passing urine in older adults.

rules.description: Long-acting sulfonylureas on the active list.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Long-acting diabetes medicine on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can cause low blood sugar that lasts a long time in older adults.

rules.description: NSAID pain relievers taken for 30 days or longer.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Long-term NSAID use
rules.risk_summary: Taking this kind of pain reliever for a long time can affect the stomach, kidneys and blood pressure in older adults.

rules.description: Muscle relaxants on the active list.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Muscle relaxant on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can cause sleepiness and unsteadiness in older adults.

rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Antipsychotic on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can raise fall risk and affect alertness in older adults.

rules.description: Opioid pain medicines on the active list.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Opioid pain medicine on the list
rules.risk_summary: This kind of medicine can cause sleepiness, constipation and falls in older adults.

rules.description: Proton pump inhibitors taken for 90 days or longer.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Long-term stomach acid medicine
rules.risk_summary: Taking this kind of medicine for a long time may be worth a periodic check in older adults.
